senses.gloss: m. pl. (παννύκτοι = παννύχιοι, S.) all-night watches (pervigilia), in gen. camps.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 68:30">Targ. Ps. LXVIII, 30</cite> <he>מפַּנִּיקְטֵיהוֹן</he> Ar. a. Ms. (ed. <he>מִפַּנְקְטֵי׳</he>, ed. Wil. <he>מְפַ׳</he>, corr. acc.).—

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 1">Lev. R. s. 1</cite> <he>היו אומות העולם … מתוך פַּנִּיקְטֵיהֶן</he> (some ed. <he>פַּנּוּקְ׳</he>) the nations were in danger of hearing the voice of divine revelation and being frightened out of their camps (Tanḥ. T’rum. 9 <he>לתוך אהליהם</he>), v. <cite ref="V00970"><he>תָּרַז</he></cite>.—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 16">Gen. R. s. 16</cite> in three things Greece was in advance of Rome, <he>בנימוסין ובפניקטין וכ׳</he> Ar. (Ms. Paris <he>בפנקיטין</he>, ed. <he>בפנקיסין</he>, <he>בפנקיסון</he>, corr. acc.) in laws, in the arrangements of camp vigils &c.
